```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r tidy}
crash_url=paste0('https://planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')
year=2025
crash_page = rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

#reading as an html doesn't let me control what ends up in the table which makes cleaning more difficult

crash_page |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(1) > font > a") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> dates

crash_page |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(2) > font") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> loc_op


crash_page |> rvest::html_elements("td:nth-child(4) > font") |>
  rvest::html_text2() -> fatalities

df = data.frame(dates=dates, fatalities=fatalities[-1], loc=loc_op[-1]) |>
  tidyr::separate(loc, into=c("location", "operator", sep="\n")) |>
  tidyr::separate(fatalities, into=c("plane_fatalities", "pass", "ground_fatalities"))
  
dplyr::glimpse(df)

```
